entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold for ten minutes. I need to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To get started, could I get your order number?

It's VF8675309. The problem is this jersey is the wrong size. It's way too tight, I can't even zip it up. I wanted to do an exchange, but I've had it with this company. I just want my money back, now.
Okay, thank you. I'm pulling up order VF8675309 for the Aero Race Jersey now. I understand it's too tight. Let me just take a moment to review the return eligibility for you.
Don't you dare give me some speech about policy. If you don't approve this, I'm going straight to social media and every review site I can find. I want to speak to your manager right now.

That won't be necessary, sir. I've just confirmed the delivery date. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, and you are well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. So... you're just approving it? No hassle?

That's correct. I've just initiated the process. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it within the next five minutes. Simply print it out, attach it to your return package, and drop it off at the post office.
Huh. Alright then. So once you get the jersey, I get my money back?

Yes. As soon as our warehouse receives and scans the item, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method in about 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. That's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It's on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
